description: This header file defines the interface for the EthSsp message bus in the Ccsp EthAgent component. It declares functions for engaging, initializing, finalizing, checking the bus, and freeing resources related to the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a specific priority and user data.
